concept.title: Misusing topic types
concept.shortdesc: Problem: Writers place all content into generic topics or mix concepts, tasks, and reference information

conbody.p: Problem: Writers place all content into generic topics or mix concepts, tasks, and reference information within a single topic.
Impact: Reduced clarity, broken information model, inconsistent outputs.

Solution: Align content with the correct topic type. Use concept topics for explanations, task topics for procedures, and reference topics for structured data. If content feels mixed, split it into separate topics and link them.
